name: Omahold
author: ZeD
description: A tiny dwarven hold that lives inside the shell: a 48x30x8 world with z-levels, seven dwarves with needs, moods and skills, digging, farming, brewing, strange moods and artifacts, caravans, goblin ambushes, floods and magma. Drawn in the colors of the active theme. Ticks slowly while you work and at full speed when you look. Bar widget, a corner window to keep an eye on it, and a fullscreen overlay to give orders: omarchy-shell omahold toggle

barWidget.description: População da fortaleza; acende quando algo acontece. Clique abre o mundo, botão direito liga a janelinha de canto.
